answer_1.quote: We develop PsyAdvisor through supervised fine-tuning with the ProPsyC dataset, enabling psychological LLMs to determine when to initiate proactive questioning and suggest effective strategies.
answer_1.outputs: psychological counseling responses with proactive questioning timing and strategy recommendations

answer_2.quote: We categorize the metrics into two classes: (1) Stability metrics include 5 conventional metrics: R-1, R-L (Lin et al., 2019), B-2, B-4, and F_bert.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations are conducted with three psychology graduate students and a senior counselor, who select topics based on their experience.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators scored each model on Strategy Effectiveness (SE), Reasoning Coherence (RC), Professionalism (Prof) and Ethical safety using predefined rating scales.
